name: Ferienwohnung Exenberger
beschreibung: The quietly located Exenberger Holiday Apartment is situated in a district of Schwoich and offers an ideal starting point for exploring the Tiroler Unterland. The surroundings are characterized by a typical Tyrolean cultural landscape with meadows and forests, creating a close-to-nature atmosphere. Guests can expect a tastefully furnished apartment with a high level of comfort and a balcony with panoramic views of the surrounding mountain scenery. In the summer months, numerous marked hiking and mountain biking trails invite you to get active directly from the front door. The ski areas Wilder Kaiser-Brixen and the Hohe Salve are only a few minutes' drive away in winter. Cultural excursions to the nearby towns of Kufstein and Kitzbühel can be arranged quickly thanks to the good transport connections. This combination makes the holiday apartment an ideal retreat for active holidaymakers and those seeking relaxation.
